subject.title: fix(codex): coalesce in-flight dynamic tool calls

question: Should OpenClaw treat concurrent same-thread, same-turn Codex dynamic-tool requests with distinct `callId` values and equal arguments as one retried operation or as independently meaningful operations?
rationale: Codex retains `callId` for each dynamic-tool operation, while this PR intentionally collapses those IDs before execution and observer accounting; code review cannot safely choose that semantics without owner intent.

options.title: Define retry coalescing
options.body: Document the exact duplicate-delivery predicate and adjust the implementation so every accepted request keeps its own response and operation accounting while one eligible execution is shared.

options.title: Preserve per-call execution
options.body: Keep the existing `callId`-scoped execution behavior until Codex provides an explicit duplicate-delivery signal or an owner-approved operation identity contract.

recommendation.title: Define retry coalescing
recommendation.body: Document the exact duplicate-delivery predicate and adjust the implementation so every accepted request keeps its own response and operation accounting while one eligible execution is shared.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed implementation and can incorporate an owner-selected contract, while a current-main feature owner could not be verified from the available read-only evidence.
